title: Penguin Logistics Card Express
lines: Time flies, and soon the Doctors will usher in our 4th year Anniversary together with Arknights. To commemorate this joyous occasion, Penguin Logistics will be helping us out to organize a Penguin Logistics Card Express Event, dispatching all their employees to deliver the Doctors' greeting cards and well wishes to everywhere on Terra and sharing the festive atmosphere with everyone.
*We recommend participating in the event on your PC for an optimal experience.
SEND A CARD: Doctors can use the tools on the official site to create their own greeting cards, to share their wishes and thoughts for the new year with them ( Maximum 3 cards per person )

READ A CARD: After making and sending your first card, Penguin Logistics will begin to deliver the greeting cards sent by the Doctors and the card checking option to read other submissions will be unlocked, so read and give Likes to your favourites, and you might find some surprises waiting for you~ ( You can read up to a maximum of 30 cards per day, and this limit will be lifted during the final stage of the event )
PENGUIN LOGISTICS: Check out how much Terra appreciates your submissions! ( Data will refresh daily at 12:00 and 00:00 )
How to enter the Lucky Draw

1. Via Social Media: Make and submit greeting cards on the designated webpage, and then share the event or the card you received from Texas on your social media accounts (X/Facebook) to participate in the Lucky Draw. Add a message while adhering to the official template (event tag #CardExpressAK must be retained or submission will be considered invalid), and successfully posting on the platofrm will count as a lucky draw entry. After the event concludes, the Operations Team will randomly award gift cards worth $50 to 50 Doctors with valid entries.

2. Via Website: Participate in the event and collect all Rhodes Island cards to enter the lucky draw. Doctors must be level 20 and above to qualify, and each account can only participate once for a chance to win 600 Ordundum , limited to 50 winners.

*The list of winners will be announced on the official Arknights Twitter/Facebook pages. Please contact arknights.event@yo-star.com with a screenshot of your social media homepage and in-game UID to redeem your prize.
1. Each submission must consist of customized text as well as drawings and stickers provided by the website. Cards that lack customized text or are filled with spam only will be invalidated.
2. Submissions with content related to politics, violence, pornography, grotesque, controversy, or those violating the rules will be invalidated. Commercial contents are also prohibited.

3. By submitting the card, the creator agrees to allow Yostar the right to use the work in official Arknights content or on its and its affiliates' social platform accounts. The ownership of the work and other rights remain with the creator.

4. The final explanation of the activity belongs to Yostar Games, the operation team of Arknights. If players find any violations against the rules or have any questions, please feel free to contact us: arknights.event@yo-star.com .
